newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian dlr steady, bonds edge up on data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian dlr steady, bonds edge up on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar was steady and bonds firmed after news that August mechandise imports rose 1.0 percent, at the low end of market expectations.
The dollar held at a pre-data US$0.7905/10, while the December 10-year bond futures contract rose to the day's high of 92.035 compared with a pre-data 92.010.
Median forecasts for imports had centred on a 2.2 percent rise after the 2.8 percent drop in July with forecasts ranging from a 1.0 percent fall to a 5.0 percent increase.
